episodes.synopsis: For four hundred years, a family of thieves has plagued the world with a series of handicraft thefts. Under the motto of there is nothing you cannot steal, no matter the risk, now, under the name of MØUSE, which has passed from generation to generation, it is the turn of the twelfth successor: Muon Sorata to continue with the family trade together with the help of his three beautiful apprentices.
episodes.title: Steal:01 The Name is Mouse

episodes.synopsis: They challenge MØUSE to rob the Odaiba tower, he accepts the challenge.
episodes.title: Steal:02 There Is Nothing that Mouse Cannot Steal
Steal:03 She Will Not Accept Destiny

episodes.synopsis: Muon has a date with Machiko before stealing the Tear from Muse.
episodes.title: Steal:04 Mouse Will Not Abandon a Comrade

episodes.synopsis: Hatsuki tries a new machine created to erase memory, but it fails and leaves his consciousness inside the computer.
episodes.title: Steal:05 Target Is Hatsuki

episodes.synopsis: MØUSE enters the computer to "steal" Hatsuki, there he meets various Hatsuki personalities.
episodes.title: Steal:06 Country of Electronics' Mouse

episodes.synopsis: Tell the story before Yayoi joined the MØUSE team.
episodes.title: Steal:07 A Female University Student that Hates Men

episodes.synopsis: Yayoi's story continues, the events that finally make her want to be part of the MØUSE team are detailed.
episodes.title: Steal:08 Sweet Awakening

episodes.synopsis: Housu is an organization that is in charge of protecting objects of cultural value, so they send Wang to arrest MØUSE
episodes.title: Steal:09 The Name Is "Wang"

episodes.synopsis: MØUSE is about to steal the Celestial Clock, this time the security measures are greater than ever.
episodes.title: Steal:10 Undying Man

episodes.synopsis: Wang has MØUSE cornered, he manages to turn the tables but Wang has one more hostage left.
episodes.title: Steal:11 Mouse Never Gives Up

episodes.synopsis: Last chapter, everyone wants to please MØUSE.
episodes.title: Steal:12 Mouse's Dreams Will Never End
